hold_reason: review: NVIDIA: Meaning incorrect: A Look Out Circular (LOC) restricts a person's travel/immigration, not their holding of a post/position.
objections: NVIDIA: Meaning incorrect: A Look Out Circular (LOC) restricts a person's travel/immigration, not their holding of a post/position.

Google: The Hindi meaning states 'एक नोटिस जो जांच में व्यक्ति को पद से रोकता है' (a notice that prevents a person from holding a post in an investigation), which is incorrect; a Look Out Circular (LOC) is actually used to restrict a person from leaving the country.
